ops.old: Flathead fillets dipped in buttermilk and crunchy cayenne cornmeal, fried crisp, with a tangy buttermilk slaw, hot sauce and lemon. Mix 100g cornmeal, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp paprika, half a teaspoon cayenne and salt. Dip 700g flathead fillets in 200ml buttermilk, then press into the cornmeal. Shallow fry in 1cm of oil at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes a side until crisp. For slaw, toss a quarter each of green and red cabbage, finely shredded, and 1 grated carrot with 100ml buttermilk, 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tsp sugar. Serve with lemon wedges and hot sauce.
